title: Solving Linear Equations
summary: Variables on both sides, brackets, negatives and fractions, step by balanced step.

ib.note: Linear equations in one variable are MYP 3 Algebra

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Linear Equations in One Variable
Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 7: Finding the Unknown

objectives: I can solve equations with variables on both sides.
I can solve equations with brackets and fractions.
I can explain and check each step.
misconceptions: When moving a term across =, you don't change its sign.
In 3(x − 2) only the x is multiplied by 3.
Fractions make an equation unsolvable without a calculator.
